profile.cache: Fresh browser context and clear HTTP cache for every run; empty localStorage/IndexedDB/CacheStorage; service workers allowed
profile.tick: Actual jobs/tick and all page/Auth/read requests; normal worker advancement allowed
profile.scroll: Initial viewport observed for5s after firstcard; then scroll600px/500ms until five distinct actual img.currentSrc photos have decoded (or25steps). FirstFive reports those natural sources in DOMorder; other photo downloads/prefetches separate.
